causal_rule.error_filter: 4th-order Butterworth SOS, causal, separate per arm and horizon
causal_rule.criterion: mean squared filtered residual over last L seconds of fully matured target blocks
causal_rule.decision_frequency: each 10 ms block; hold choice during an active 100 ms transition
causal_rule.cold_start: v2; no hindsight tone labels enter any causal rule

oracles.file: best static arm per file and horizon by the primary metric
oracles.terminal_window: merge a final tail shorter than 0.5 s into the preceding window
oracles.window: dynamic programming minimizes additive window tone-bin residual power (whole low band if no tones), including every rendered transition; best static arm is a predeclared fallback when better on full-file score
oracles.limit: Privileged hindsight benchmark, not a universal upper bound on arbitrary selectors. Full-file Welch and additive 2 s window losses differ.

score.recordings: unchanged first-40% calibration, score remaining suffix, first channel, causal resampling, max 180 s
score.synthetic: 44 existing development scenes plus 8 buzz scenes, score existing final 4 s
score.primary: median of paired tone-bin gain differences versus v2 at 20 ms across decoded acoustic public recordings with reference tones
score.aggregation: one paired value per file; never count its windows as independent sources
score.secondary: 120 ms, whole band, strong-source regressions, per-cohort results, source-author clustering, personal files, synthetic controls
score.strong_source_rule: v2 tone gain >=3 dB at the scored horizon

decision.below_threshold: Do not build the tested selector design; diagnose the strong-tone predictor loss. This is a scoped engineering stop, not an impossibility theorem.
decision.above_threshold: Assess all fixed causal lookbacks. Do not auto-promote or download a new test in this audit.
decision.causal_readiness: paired median >=0.5 dB, >=half oracle paired median, no >1 dB loss on v2>=3 dB sources at 20 ms, no more recording band-boost cases than v2 and no whole-band boosts

protocol.missing_rule: One known malformed original file is excluded in advance and reported. No substitutions. Other execution failures stop the run.
protocol.scope: Offline reference prediction only. No downloads, audio streams, engine changes or physical ANC claims.
